categories.name: Normal Care Ward Admission
categories.description: Patient is admitted to a normal care ward (Admission NC), advancing general inpatient progression and judged against post-discharge indicators such as post-discharge ER return.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=15 under Goal 5 (OR-decomposed). Evidence from variants like V0008 shows this pathway being realized independently without IC admission.

categories.name: Intensive Care Unit Admission
categories.description: Patient is admitted to an intensive care unit (Admission IC). This option harms the softgoal 'Minimize time-to-treatment' due to its negative contribution profile, and is measured against discharge and return outcomes.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=16 under Goal 5 (OR-decomposed). Sample variants like V0605 and V0317 show direct realization of intensive care admissions.

categories.name: Release Variant A
categories.description: Patient is discharged via Release A, contributing positively to 'Avoid post-discharge deterioration' and tracked against post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=17 under Goal 6 (OR-decomposed). Realized in multiple sampled variants including V0008 and V0551.

categories.name: Release Variant B
categories.description: Patient is discharged via Release B, advancing the softgoal 'Avoid post-discharge deterioration' and evaluated against post-discharge return metrics.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=18 under Goal 6 (OR-decomposed). Sampled in variants V0068 and V0145.

categories.name: Release Variant C
categories.description: Patient is discharged via Release C, helping avoid post-discharge deterioration as part of the discharge goal options.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=19 under Goal 6 (OR-decomposed). Observed directly in variant V0710.

categories.name: Release Variant D
categories.description: Patient is discharged via Release D, contributing to the organizational softgoal of preventing patient deterioration post-discharge.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=20 under Goal 6 (OR-decomposed). Observed in variant V0273.

categories.name: Release Variant E
categories.description: Patient is discharged via Release E, representing one of the permitted resolution pathways for an admitted case.
categories.rationale: Mapped 1:1 to declared alternative id=21 under Goal 6 (OR-decomposed). Maintained as a standard declared alternative per the goal model decomposition.
